note: The prompts of the place plates (assets-src/venus/RECIPE.md, section Place plates). comp: the composition take of a level, one input, <tag>/guide.png. tile: the four detail tiles of a level, one input each, <tag>/in-<tile>.png.
comp:
Image 1 is a square top-down map (straight down, nadir view, north at the top) of the cloud tops of Venus at dusk. The map is unfinished. One part of it is a finished, sharp aerial photograph: tall dark cumulus towers and cloud banks on a shadowed cloud deck, their tops and upper-left flanks lit warm gold by a very low Sun in the upper left, with long soft shadows and pale rays of light running toward the lower right. The rest of the map is only a smooth, out-of-focus underpainting without any cloud detail.

TASK: Finish the map. Paint the smooth, out-of-focus parts as the same cloud field as the sharp part, seen from straight above, so that the whole square becomes one continuous, equally sharp nadir aerial photograph of one place.

KEEP: The sharp part stays exactly as it is: same position, same shapes, same brightness, same colors. Nothing is moved, scaled, rotated, cropped or recomposed.

PAINT: Everywhere the map is smooth or blurred, add real cloud structure at the same scale as in the sharp part: cauliflower cumulus tops and towers seen from directly above, long cloud banks, troughs between them, fine cottony texture. Every raised cloud top is lit warm on its upper-left side and lays a long soft shadow toward the lower right. Follow the brightness and the color of the underpainting at every place: where it is dark, paint a dark, shadowed cloud deck with only a few lit tops; where it is bright, paint a bright, sunlit, hazy cloud deck; where it is grey or olive, paint a muted grey-tan cloud deck. The new cloud forms grow out of the sharp part with no visible border between old and new.

Strict nadir view from edge to edge: no horizon, no sky, no Sun disc, no stars, no planet limb, no vignette, no border, no frame, no text, no watermark. Sharp focus everywhere, no blur, no smeared streaks, no painterly brush strokes.
tile:
Faithful 2x enlargement of Image 1, a square crop of a top-down (straight down, nadir) aerial photograph of the cloud tops of Venus at dusk: one thick deck of cloud with towers and banks seen from directly above, north at the top. The camera looks straight down: there is no horizon, no sky and no Sun anywhere in the picture, every part of the frame is cloud seen from above.

LAYOUT, TONE AND COLOR LOCK:
Image 1 fixes the picture. Every cloud tower, cloud bank, bright cloud top, streak, ray of light, soft shadow and darker trough that can be seen in Image 1 stays at its exact position, with its exact outline, brightness and color. Smooth areas of Image 1 stay evenly toned: do not put a new tower, a new dark shadow, a new glow or a new bright patch where Image 1 has none. Keep the palette of Image 1 exactly: dark brown shadowed deck, warm gold light on the cloud tops, pale cream haze, muted grey-tan in the dimmer parts. Same framing, same scale, same crop: nothing is shifted, zoomed, rotated or recomposed. Scaled back down to the size of Image 1, the result must look identical to Image 1.

DETAIL TO ADD, ALL OF IT SMALLER THAN THE SMALLEST FEATURE OF IMAGE 1:
Image 1 has too few pixels in places and is soft there. Give every part of it the fine grain of a sharp, high resolution aerial photograph taken straight down: the outlines of the banks break up into small knotted cauliflower billows and crisp scalloped edges; the surfaces of the banks show fine cottony cumulus texture; the smooth areas show fine fibrous streaks, faint ripples and rows of tiny soft puffs; thin wisps of haze feather the edges of the darker gaps. It is cloud everywhere, soft and vaporous, never rock, sand or foam. The small billows catch warm light on their upper-left side and lay short soft shadows to the lower right. Every part is in sharp focus down to the pixel. No blur, no noise, no grain stipple, no sharpening halos, no painterly brush strokes.

Strict nadir aerial texture edge to edge. No horizon, no sky, no Sun, no stars, no planet limb, no vignette, no border, no text, no watermark.
